description: Shows one social drop (post) in full: status, type, source, channel, hook, caption, slides and publish counts. Use when the user asks what a post says, why it failed or is held for review, or whether it is ready to publish. Not for listing posts (use list_team_drops). Returns the post's details; video and image links show in the card only.

drop_id.description: ID of the drop. Get it from list_team_drops or create_drop.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_drop
title: Get social drop
